This page lists every requirement of **[NL-CS-WSCA conditions](/edi-stelsel/documents/nl-cs-wsca-conditions)** (Conditions for the Underlying Platform Supporting AVA\_VAN.5 Evaluation, version RC1.1) as published on 6 November 2026. The [PDF](pathname:///files/edi-stelsel/2026-11-06/NL-CS-WSCA-conditions-RC1.1_-_for_publ.pdf) is authoritative: each requirement links to the page it is on. You can also read the [full text](/edi-stelsel/text/nl-cs-wsca-conditions) or [search all requirements](/edi-stelsel/requirements).

## 2 Security requirements Operational Environment

[Read section 2 in the full text](/edi-stelsel/text/nl-cs-wsca-conditions#s-2)

### ENV-DEDICATED\_PLATFROM {#env-dedicated_platfrom}

The WSCA operates on a dedicated underlying hardened platform and hardware that forms part of its trusted operational environment. This platform is responsible for providing the security mechanisms necessary to protect the WSCA against unauthorised access, modification, interference and exploitation (see detailed requirements in section 5). No applications, services, workloads or processing functions unrelated to the WSCA shall be installed or operated on the hardened platforms and on top dedicated hardware. Consequently, deployment of the WSCA as a shared cloud application is not permitted.

**Condition** · obligation: **mandatory** · [PDF page 8](pathname:///files/edi-stelsel/2026-11-06/NL-CS-WSCA-conditions-RC1.1_-_for_publ.pdf#page=8)



### ENV-TRUSTED-ADMIN {#env-trusted-admin}

Administrators are appropriately trained, follow established policies and guidance, and are trusted to act without malicious intent. They ensure that passwords and credentials have sufficient strength and entropy. The platform enforces dual control for administrative tasks to prevent a single administrator from performing sensitive or potentially malicious actions alone.

**Condition** · obligation: **mandatory** · [PDF page 9](pathname:///files/edi-stelsel/2026-11-06/NL-CS-WSCA-conditions-RC1.1_-_for_publ.pdf#page=9)



### ENV-GATEWAY {#env-gateway}

The WSCA platform shall not be directly exposed to the Internet. External communication is mediated through a gateway platform positioned between the WSCA platform and the Internet. This provides an additional security boundary for network communication and reduces the direct exposure of the WSCA execution environment. The gateway implements at least DDoS protection, intrusion detection, antivirus functionality and firewall functionality.

**Condition** · obligation: **mandatory** · [PDF page 9](pathname:///files/edi-stelsel/2026-11-06/NL-CS-WSCA-conditions-RC1.1_-_for_publ.pdf#page=9)



### ENV-DATABASE {#env-database}

The WSCD and security-relevant databases supporting the WSCA shall be located within the same protected operational environment as the WSCA platform and shall not be directly accessible from untrusted networks.

**Condition** · obligation: **mandatory** · [PDF page 9](pathname:///files/edi-stelsel/2026-11-06/NL-CS-WSCA-conditions-RC1.1_-_for_publ.pdf#page=9)



### ENV-WSCD-CHANNEL {#env-wscd-channel}

Communication channels between the WSCA and the WSCD and the WSCA the gateway platform shall be authenticated and encrypted. The communication mechanism shall protect the confidentiality and integrity of all exchanged security-relevant data and cryptographic commands, and shall prevent unauthorised interception, modification, replay, or impersonation of communicating parties. The communication channel between the WSCA and the WSCD shall use a dedicated physical connection, isolated from all other computer systems.

**Condition** · obligation: **mandatory** · [PDF page 9](pathname:///files/edi-stelsel/2026-11-06/NL-CS-WSCA-conditions-RC1.1_-_for_publ.pdf#page=9)



### ENV-ENVIRONMENT {#env-environment}

The TOE and its underlying platform shall be located in a physically secured environment that protects against unauthorised physical access, tampering, theft, and physical interference. Access shall be restricted to authorised personnel through appropriate physical access controls. Physical security measures shall protect the WSCA, WSCD the databases and the gateway against attacks that could compromise their integrity, confidentiality, or availability, including attacks within the scope of the AVA\_VAN.5 vulnerability assessment.

**Condition** · obligation: **mandatory** · [PDF page 9](pathname:///files/edi-stelsel/2026-11-06/NL-CS-WSCA-conditions-RC1.1_-_for_publ.pdf#page=9)



## 4 Security Principles for the Underlying Platform

[Read section 4 in the full text](/edi-stelsel/text/nl-cs-wsca-conditions#s-4)

### 01 — Minimal Configuration {#01}

The underlying platform shall be configured with only those operating system components, services, drivers, interfaces and functions that are required for the secure operation of the WSCA. Unnecessary functionality shall be disabled or removed.

**Security principle** · obligation: **mandatory** · [PDF page 12](pathname:///files/edi-stelsel/2026-11-06/NL-CS-WSCA-conditions-RC1.1_-_for_publ.pdf#page=12)



### 02 — Limited Execution {#02}

The underlying platform shall restrict execution to authorised software, processes and services required for the operation of the WSCA. Execution of unauthorised software shall be prevented.

**Security principle** · obligation: **mandatory** · [PDF page 12](pathname:///files/edi-stelsel/2026-11-06/NL-CS-WSCA-conditions-RC1.1_-_for_publ.pdf#page=12)



### 03 — Least Privilege {#03}

The underlying platform shall ensure that the WSCA and its supporting processes operate with only the privileges necessary to perform their specified functions.

**Security principle** · obligation: **mandatory** · [PDF page 12](pathname:///files/edi-stelsel/2026-11-06/NL-CS-WSCA-conditions-RC1.1_-_for_publ.pdf#page=12)



### 04 — Process Isolation {#04}

The underlying platform shall provide isolation between the WSCA and other processes such that an unauthorised process cannot access, modify or interfere with the WSCA or its security-relevant data.

**Security principle** · obligation: **mandatory** · [PDF page 12](pathname:///files/edi-stelsel/2026-11-06/NL-CS-WSCA-conditions-RC1.1_-_for_publ.pdf#page=12)



### 05 — Memory Protection {#05}

The underlying platform shall protect memory allocated to the WSCA against unauthorised reading, modification and execution by other processes or users.

**Security principle** · obligation: **mandatory** · [PDF page 12](pathname:///files/edi-stelsel/2026-11-06/NL-CS-WSCA-conditions-RC1.1_-_for_publ.pdf#page=12)



### 06 — Controlled Interfaces {#06}

The underlying platform shall restrict access to system interfaces, devices, files, inter-process communication mechanisms and other resources to those required for the operation of the WSCA.

**Security principle** · obligation: **mandatory** · [PDF page 12](pathname:///files/edi-stelsel/2026-11-06/NL-CS-WSCA-conditions-RC1.1_-_for_publ.pdf#page=12)



### 07 — Platform Integrity {#07}

The underlying platform shall provide mechanisms to prevent or detect unauthorised modification of platform components that could affect the security of the WSCA.

**Security principle** · obligation: **mandatory** · [PDF page 12](pathname:///files/edi-stelsel/2026-11-06/NL-CS-WSCA-conditions-RC1.1_-_for_publ.pdf#page=12)



### 08 — Network Protection {#08}

The underlying platform shall expose only the network services, protocols and ports required for the operation of the WSCA. Direct network access from the WSCA to untrusted networks shall be prevented where it is not required for the WSCA's specified operation.

**Security principle** · obligation: **mandatory** · [PDF page 12](pathname:///files/edi-stelsel/2026-11-06/NL-CS-WSCA-conditions-RC1.1_-_for_publ.pdf#page=12)



### 09 — WSCA Data Protection {#09}

The underlying platform shall protect WSCA security-relevant data, including configuration data, credentials and other sensitive information, against unauthorised disclosure, modification or deletion.

**Security principle** · obligation: **mandatory** · [PDF page 12](pathname:///files/edi-stelsel/2026-11-06/NL-CS-WSCA-conditions-RC1.1_-_for_publ.pdf#page=12)



### 10 — Privilege Escalation Protection {#10}

The underlying platform shall prevent a process or user operating with limited privileges from obtaining privileges that could be used to compromise or interfere with the WSCA.

**Security principle** · obligation: **mandatory** · [PDF page 12](pathname:///files/edi-stelsel/2026-11-06/NL-CS-WSCA-conditions-RC1.1_-_for_publ.pdf#page=12)



### 11 — Security-Relevant Logging {#11}

The underlying platform shall provide logging of security-relevant events necessary to support the detection and investigation of events that could affect the security of the WSCA.

**Security principle** · obligation: **mandatory** · [PDF page 12](pathname:///files/edi-stelsel/2026-11-06/NL-CS-WSCA-conditions-RC1.1_-_for_publ.pdf#page=12)



### 12 — Vulnerability Management {#12}

The underlying platform shall be maintained using a defined vulnerability and security-update management process to ensure that known vulnerabilities that could affect the WSCA are assessed and appropriately remediated.

**Security principle** · obligation: **mandatory** · [PDF page 13](pathname:///files/edi-stelsel/2026-11-06/NL-CS-WSCA-conditions-RC1.1_-_for_publ.pdf#page=13)



### 13 — Cyber Security Monitoring {#13}

The underlying platform shall be continuously monitored for security-relevant events, anomalous behaviour, and indicators of compromise that could affect the security of the WSCA. Detected events shall be analysed and, where necessary, trigger appropriate alerts and incident response measures.

**Security principle** · obligation: **mandatory** · [PDF page 13](pathname:///files/edi-stelsel/2026-11-06/NL-CS-WSCA-conditions-RC1.1_-_for_publ.pdf#page=13)



## 5.1 Hardware Requirements

[Read section 5.1 in the full text](/edi-stelsel/text/nl-cs-wsca-conditions#s-5-1)

### HW-01 {#hw-01}

The host system shall be configured with only the hardware components required for the operation of the WSCA platform. Unnecessary hardware devices and interfaces shall be disabled or removed where technically possible.

**Platform requirement** · obligation: **mandatory** · [PDF page 14](pathname:///files/edi-stelsel/2026-11-06/NL-CS-WSCA-conditions-RC1.1_-_for_publ.pdf#page=14)

- **Security principle:** [Minimal Configuration](/edi-stelsel/requirements/nl-cs-wsca-conditions#01)



### HW-02 {#hw-02}

The hardware shall support the platform's mechanisms for restricting execution to authorised platform and WSCA software. Hardware mechanisms that could allow unauthorised code execution or bypass platform controls shall be disabled or appropriately controlled.

**Platform requirement** · obligation: **mandatory** · [PDF page 14](pathname:///files/edi-stelsel/2026-11-06/NL-CS-WSCA-conditions-RC1.1_-_for_publ.pdf#page=14)

- **Security principle:** [Limited Execution](/edi-stelsel/requirements/nl-cs-wsca-conditions#02)



### HW-03 {#hw-03}

Hardware resources and privileged hardware functions shall only be accessible through authorised platform mechanisms and to components requiring such access for their specified functions.

**Platform requirement** · obligation: **mandatory** · [PDF page 14](pathname:///files/edi-stelsel/2026-11-06/NL-CS-WSCA-conditions-RC1.1_-_for_publ.pdf#page=14)

- **Security principle:** [Least Privilege](/edi-stelsel/requirements/nl-cs-wsca-conditions#03)



### HW-04 {#hw-04}

The host hardware shall provide, where supported, hardware-assisted mechanisms for isolating processes and execution environments, including processor privilege levels and virtual memory protection.

**Platform requirement** · obligation: **mandatory** · [PDF page 14](pathname:///files/edi-stelsel/2026-11-06/NL-CS-WSCA-conditions-RC1.1_-_for_publ.pdf#page=14)

- **Security principle:** [Process Isolation](/edi-stelsel/requirements/nl-cs-wsca-conditions#04)



### HW-05 {#hw-05}

The processor and memory subsystem shall support hardware-assisted memory protection mechanisms. These mechanisms shall be enabled and configured to prevent unauthorised access to memory allocated to the WSCA.

**Platform requirement** · obligation: **mandatory** · [PDF page 14](pathname:///files/edi-stelsel/2026-11-06/NL-CS-WSCA-conditions-RC1.1_-_for_publ.pdf#page=14)

- **Security principle:** [Memory Protection](/edi-stelsel/requirements/nl-cs-wsca-conditions#05)



### HW-06 {#hw-06}

Physical interfaces and peripheral devices shall be limited to those required for the operation and administration of the WSCA platform. Unnecessary interfaces, such as unused USB, storage or peripheral interfaces, shall be disabled or physically restricted where possible.

**Platform requirement** · obligation: **mandatory** · [PDF page 14](pathname:///files/edi-stelsel/2026-11-06/NL-CS-WSCA-conditions-RC1.1_-_for_publ.pdf#page=14)

- **Security principle:** [Controlled Interfaces](/edi-stelsel/requirements/nl-cs-wsca-conditions#06)



### HW-07 {#hw-07}

Where supported by the hardware, mechanisms such as a hardware root of trust, Trusted Platform Module (TPM), measured boot or Secure Boot shall be used to support verification of the integrity of the platform during system initialisation.

**Platform requirement** · obligation: **mandatory** · [PDF page 14](pathname:///files/edi-stelsel/2026-11-06/NL-CS-WSCA-conditions-RC1.1_-_for_publ.pdf#page=14)

- **Security principle:** [Platform Integrity](/edi-stelsel/requirements/nl-cs-wsca-conditions#07)



### HW-08 {#hw-08}

Network interfaces shall be limited to those required for WSCA operation and platform administration. Unused network interfaces shall be disabled, and the hardware configuration shall not provide an uncontrolled path to untrusted networks.

**Platform requirement** · obligation: **mandatory** · [PDF page 15](pathname:///files/edi-stelsel/2026-11-06/NL-CS-WSCA-conditions-RC1.1_-_for_publ.pdf#page=15)

- **Security principle:** [Network Protection](/edi-stelsel/requirements/nl-cs-wsca-conditions#08)



### HW-09 {#hw-09}

Hardware resources used to store or process WSCA security-relevant data shall be protected against unauthorised physical and logical access. Where hardware security mechanisms are available, they shall be used where required to protect sensitive data.

**Platform requirement** · obligation: **mandatory** · [PDF page 15](pathname:///files/edi-stelsel/2026-11-06/NL-CS-WSCA-conditions-RC1.1_-_for_publ.pdf#page=15)

- **Security principle:** [WSCA Data Protection](/edi-stelsel/requirements/nl-cs-wsca-conditions#09)



### HW-10 {#hw-10}

The hardware shall support processor and platform security mechanisms that prevent lower-privileged software from directly accessing privileged hardware resources or bypassing the access-control mechanisms of the underlying platform.

**Platform requirement** · obligation: **mandatory** · [PDF page 15](pathname:///files/edi-stelsel/2026-11-06/NL-CS-WSCA-conditions-RC1.1_-_for_publ.pdf#page=15)

- **Security principle:** [Privilege Escalation Protection](/edi-stelsel/requirements/nl-cs-wsca-conditions#10)



### HW-11 {#hw-11}

Where hardware security events are relevant to the security of the WSCA, the platform shall provide mechanisms to capture or expose such events to the platform logging and monitoring functions.

**Platform requirement** · obligation: **mandatory** · [PDF page 15](pathname:///files/edi-stelsel/2026-11-06/NL-CS-WSCA-conditions-RC1.1_-_for_publ.pdf#page=15)

- **Security principle:** [Security-Relevant Logging](/edi-stelsel/requirements/nl-cs-wsca-conditions#11)



### HW-12 {#hw-12}

The hardware platform, including firmware and microcode, shall be subject to a defined vulnerability-management process. Security updates addressing vulnerabilities that could affect the WSCA shall be assessed and applied in accordance with the applicable security-update policy.

**Platform requirement** · obligation: **mandatory** · [PDF page 15](pathname:///files/edi-stelsel/2026-11-06/NL-CS-WSCA-conditions-RC1.1_-_for_publ.pdf#page=15)

- **Security principle:** [Vulnerability Management](/edi-stelsel/requirements/nl-cs-wsca-conditions#12)



### HW-13 {#hw-13}

The hardware platform shall support the collection and reporting of security-relevant hardware events, where technically available, including hardware faults, integrity violations, and indicators of unauthorised physical or logical access. Such events shall be made available to the platform's security monitoring mechanisms for analysis and, where necessary, trigger appropriate alerts.

**Platform requirement** · obligation: **mandatory** · [PDF page 15](pathname:///files/edi-stelsel/2026-11-06/NL-CS-WSCA-conditions-RC1.1_-_for_publ.pdf#page=15)

- **Security principle:** [Cyber Security Monitoring](/edi-stelsel/requirements/nl-cs-wsca-conditions#13)



## 5.2 Boot and Initialisation Layer Requirements

[Read section 5.2 in the full text](/edi-stelsel/text/nl-cs-wsca-conditions#s-5-2)

### BOOT-01 {#boot-01}

The boot and initialisation environment shall be configured with only the firmware, boot components and configuration required to initialise the platform and start the authorised operating system. Unnecessary boot functionality shall be disabled where technically possible.

**Platform requirement** · obligation: **mandatory** · [PDF page 15](pathname:///files/edi-stelsel/2026-11-06/NL-CS-WSCA-conditions-RC1.1_-_for_publ.pdf#page=15)

- **Security principle:** [Minimal Configuration](/edi-stelsel/requirements/nl-cs-wsca-conditions#01)



### BOOT-02 {#boot-02}

The boot process shall permit execution only of authorised firmware, bootloader components and operating system components. Unauthorised code shall not be permitted to execute during platform initialisation.

**Platform requirement** · obligation: **mandatory** · [PDF page 15](pathname:///files/edi-stelsel/2026-11-06/NL-CS-WSCA-conditions-RC1.1_-_for_publ.pdf#page=15)

- **Security principle:** [Limited Execution](/edi-stelsel/requirements/nl-cs-wsca-conditions#02)



### BOOT-03 {#boot-03}

Boot and initialisation components shall operate with only the privileges and access to hardware resources necessary to perform platform initialisation and start the authorised operating system.

**Platform requirement** · obligation: **mandatory** · [PDF page 15](pathname:///files/edi-stelsel/2026-11-06/NL-CS-WSCA-conditions-RC1.1_-_for_publ.pdf#page=15)

- **Security principle:** [Least Privilege](/edi-stelsel/requirements/nl-cs-wsca-conditions#03)



### BOOT-04 {#boot-04}

The boot environment shall prevent unauthorised or untrusted components from gaining access to or interfering with security-relevant boot processes and initialisation components.

**Platform requirement** · obligation: **mandatory** · [PDF page 15](pathname:///files/edi-stelsel/2026-11-06/NL-CS-WSCA-conditions-RC1.1_-_for_publ.pdf#page=15)

- **Security principle:** [Process Isolation](/edi-stelsel/requirements/nl-cs-wsca-conditions#04)



### BOOT-05 {#boot-05}

The boot environment shall use available hardware and firmware mechanisms to protect memory used during initialisation against unauthorised access or modification.

**Platform requirement** · obligation: **mandatory** · [PDF page 16](pathname:///files/edi-stelsel/2026-11-06/NL-CS-WSCA-conditions-RC1.1_-_for_publ.pdf#page=16)

- **Security principle:** [Memory Protection](/edi-stelsel/requirements/nl-cs-wsca-conditions#05)



### BOOT-06 {#boot-06}

Access to firmware configuration, boot interfaces and hardware configuration functions shall be restricted to authorised personnel or authorised management mechanisms. Unnecessary boot interfaces shall be disabled or otherwise restricted.

**Platform requirement** · obligation: **mandatory** · [PDF page 16](pathname:///files/edi-stelsel/2026-11-06/NL-CS-WSCA-conditions-RC1.1_-_for_publ.pdf#page=16)

- **Security principle:** [Controlled Interfaces](/edi-stelsel/requirements/nl-cs-wsca-conditions#06)



### BOOT-07 {#boot-07}

The boot process shall provide mechanisms to verify the authenticity and/or integrity of firmware, bootloader and operating system components before they are executed. Where supported, Secure Boot, measured boot or equivalent integrity mechanisms shall be enabled and appropriately configured.

**Platform requirement** · obligation: **mandatory** · [PDF page 16](pathname:///files/edi-stelsel/2026-11-06/NL-CS-WSCA-conditions-RC1.1_-_for_publ.pdf#page=16)

- **Security principle:** [Platform Integrity](/edi-stelsel/requirements/nl-cs-wsca-conditions#07)



### BOOT-08 {#boot-08}

Network functionality during the boot and initialisation process shall be disabled unless required for a defined platform function. Where network boot or other pre-OS network functionality is required, it shall be restricted to authorised sources and protected against unauthorised modification or execution.

**Platform requirement** · obligation: **mandatory** · [PDF page 16](pathname:///files/edi-stelsel/2026-11-06/NL-CS-WSCA-conditions-RC1.1_-_for_publ.pdf#page=16)

- **Security principle:** [Network Protection](/edi-stelsel/requirements/nl-cs-wsca-conditions#08)



### BOOT-09 {#boot-09}

The boot and initialisation process shall not expose or provide unauthorised access to WSCA security-relevant data stored on the platform. Access to storage containing WSCA data during boot shall be restricted to authorised platform components.

**Platform requirement** · obligation: **mandatory** · [PDF page 16](pathname:///files/edi-stelsel/2026-11-06/NL-CS-WSCA-conditions-RC1.1_-_for_publ.pdf#page=16)

- **Security principle:** [WSCA Data Protection](/edi-stelsel/requirements/nl-cs-wsca-conditions#09)



### BOOT-10 {#boot-10}

The boot and initialisation mechanisms shall prevent lower-trust or unauthorised components from obtaining privileged execution through manipulation of the boot process, boot configuration or firmware interfaces.

**Platform requirement** · obligation: **mandatory** · [PDF page 16](pathname:///files/edi-stelsel/2026-11-06/NL-CS-WSCA-conditions-RC1.1_-_for_publ.pdf#page=16)

- **Security principle:** [Privilege Escalation Protection](/edi-stelsel/requirements/nl-cs-wsca-conditions#10)



### BOOT-11 {#boot-11}

Where supported, security-relevant boot and integrity events, including failed integrity checks and unauthorised boot attempts, shall be recorded and made available to the platform's security monitoring mechanisms.

**Platform requirement** · obligation: **mandatory** · [PDF page 16](pathname:///files/edi-stelsel/2026-11-06/NL-CS-WSCA-conditions-RC1.1_-_for_publ.pdf#page=16)

- **Security principle:** [Security-Relevant Logging](/edi-stelsel/requirements/nl-cs-wsca-conditions#11)



### BOOT-12 {#boot-12}

Firmware, bootloader and other boot components shall be subject to a defined vulnerability-management process. Security vulnerabilities affecting the integrity or security of the WSCA platform shall be assessed and appropriately remediated.

**Platform requirement** · obligation: **mandatory** · [PDF page 16](pathname:///files/edi-stelsel/2026-11-06/NL-CS-WSCA-conditions-RC1.1_-_for_publ.pdf#page=16)

- **Security principle:** [Vulnerability Management](/edi-stelsel/requirements/nl-cs-wsca-conditions#12)



### BOOT-13 {#boot-13}

The boot and initialisation process shall support the detection of security-relevant anomalies, including unexpected boot configurations, failed integrity verification, and unauthorised changes to boot components. Detected events shall be reported to the platform's security monitoring mechanisms to enable timely investigation and response.

**Platform requirement** · obligation: **mandatory** · [PDF page 16](pathname:///files/edi-stelsel/2026-11-06/NL-CS-WSCA-conditions-RC1.1_-_for_publ.pdf#page=16)

- **Security principle:** [Cyber Security Monitoring](/edi-stelsel/requirements/nl-cs-wsca-conditions#13)



## 5.3 Operating System Kernel Requirements

[Read section 5.3 in the full text](/edi-stelsel/text/nl-cs-wsca-conditions#s-5-3)

### KERN-01 {#kern-01}

The kernel shall be configured with only the functionality, drivers, modules and interfaces required for the secure operation of the WSCA platform. Unnecessary kernel functionality shall be disabled or removed where technically possible.

**Platform requirement** · obligation: **mandatory** · [PDF page 16](pathname:///files/edi-stelsel/2026-11-06/NL-CS-WSCA-conditions-RC1.1_-_for_publ.pdf#page=16)

- **Security principle:** [Minimal Configuration](/edi-stelsel/requirements/nl-cs-wsca-conditions#01)



### KERN-02 {#kern-02}

The kernel shall prevent unauthorised kernel modules, drivers or other privileged code from being loaded or executed. Only authorised and trusted kernel components shall be permitted.

**Platform requirement** · obligation: **mandatory** · [PDF page 17](pathname:///files/edi-stelsel/2026-11-06/NL-CS-WSCA-conditions-RC1.1_-_for_publ.pdf#page=17)

- **Security principle:** [Limited Execution](/edi-stelsel/requirements/nl-cs-wsca-conditions#02)



### KERN-03 {#kern-03}

The kernel shall provide mechanisms to enforce separation between privileged and non-privileged execution and shall ensure that the WSCA operates with only the privileges required for its specified functions.

**Platform requirement** · obligation: **mandatory** · [PDF page 17](pathname:///files/edi-stelsel/2026-11-06/NL-CS-WSCA-conditions-RC1.1_-_for_publ.pdf#page=17)

- **Security principle:** [Least Privilege](/edi-stelsel/requirements/nl-cs-wsca-conditions#03)



### KERN-04 {#kern-04}

The kernel shall provide process isolation mechanisms that prevent one process from accessing, modifying or interfering with another process unless explicitly authorised.

**Platform requirement** · obligation: **mandatory** · [PDF page 17](pathname:///files/edi-stelsel/2026-11-06/NL-CS-WSCA-conditions-RC1.1_-_for_publ.pdf#page=17)

- **Security principle:** [Process Isolation](/edi-stelsel/requirements/nl-cs-wsca-conditions#04)



### KERN-05 {#kern-05}

The kernel shall enforce memory isolation and shall prevent unauthorised processes from reading, modifying or executing memory allocated to the WSCA. Hardware-assisted memory protection mechanisms shall be enabled where available.

**Platform requirement** · obligation: **mandatory** · [PDF page 17](pathname:///files/edi-stelsel/2026-11-06/NL-CS-WSCA-conditions-RC1.1_-_for_publ.pdf#page=17)

- **Security principle:** [Memory Protection](/edi-stelsel/requirements/nl-cs-wsca-conditions#05)



### KERN-06 {#kern-06}

Access to kernel interfaces, system calls, devices, IPC mechanisms and other kernel-managed resources shall be restricted according to the privileges and functions of the requesting process.

**Platform requirement** · obligation: **mandatory** · [PDF page 17](pathname:///files/edi-stelsel/2026-11-06/NL-CS-WSCA-conditions-RC1.1_-_for_publ.pdf#page=17)

- **Security principle:** [Controlled Interfaces](/edi-stelsel/requirements/nl-cs-wsca-conditions#06)



### KERN-07 {#kern-07}

The kernel shall provide mechanisms to protect the integrity of its own code, security configuration and security-relevant data during operation.

**Platform requirement** · obligation: **mandatory** · [PDF page 17](pathname:///files/edi-stelsel/2026-11-06/NL-CS-WSCA-conditions-RC1.1_-_for_publ.pdf#page=17)

- **Security principle:** [Platform Integrity](/edi-stelsel/requirements/nl-cs-wsca-conditions#07)



### KERN-08 {#kern-08}

The kernel network stack shall be configured to expose only the network functionality required by the WSCA environment. Unnecessary network protocols, interfaces and services shall be disabled.

**Platform requirement** · obligation: **mandatory** · [PDF page 17](pathname:///files/edi-stelsel/2026-11-06/NL-CS-WSCA-conditions-RC1.1_-_for_publ.pdf#page=17)

- **Security principle:** [Network Protection](/edi-stelsel/requirements/nl-cs-wsca-conditions#08)



### KERN-09 {#kern-09}

The kernel shall enforce access controls preventing unauthorised processes or users from accessing WSCA security-relevant files, memory, devices and other resources.

**Platform requirement** · obligation: **mandatory** · [PDF page 17](pathname:///files/edi-stelsel/2026-11-06/NL-CS-WSCA-conditions-RC1.1_-_for_publ.pdf#page=17)

- **Security principle:** [WSCA Data Protection](/edi-stelsel/requirements/nl-cs-wsca-conditions#09)



### KERN-10 {#kern-10}

The kernel shall provide mechanisms to prevent processes operating with limited privileges from obtaining unauthorised higher privileges or bypassing kernel access-control mechanisms.

**Platform requirement** · obligation: **mandatory** · [PDF page 17](pathname:///files/edi-stelsel/2026-11-06/NL-CS-WSCA-conditions-RC1.1_-_for_publ.pdf#page=17)

- **Security principle:** [Privilege Escalation Protection](/edi-stelsel/requirements/nl-cs-wsca-conditions#10)



### KERN-11 {#kern-11}

The kernel shall provide logging or security event mechanisms for security-relevant events that could indicate an attempt to bypass kernel security controls or compromise the WSCA.

**Platform requirement** · obligation: **mandatory** · [PDF page 17](pathname:///files/edi-stelsel/2026-11-06/NL-CS-WSCA-conditions-RC1.1_-_for_publ.pdf#page=17)

- **Security principle:** [Security-Relevant Logging](/edi-stelsel/requirements/nl-cs-wsca-conditions#11)



### KERN-12 {#kern-12}

The kernel and its security-relevant modules and drivers shall be subject to vulnerability management. Known vulnerabilities that could affect the WSCA shall be assessed and appropriately remediated.

**Platform requirement** · obligation: **mandatory** · [PDF page 17](pathname:///files/edi-stelsel/2026-11-06/NL-CS-WSCA-conditions-RC1.1_-_for_publ.pdf#page=17)

- **Security principle:** [Vulnerability Management](/edi-stelsel/requirements/nl-cs-wsca-conditions#12)



### KERN-13 {#kern-13}

The operating system kernel shall support the detection and reporting of security-relevant anomalies, including unauthorised privilege escalation, unexpected kernel module loading, violations of access controls, and attempts to exploit kernel vulnerabilities. Detected events shall be made available to the platform's security monitoring mechanisms for analysis and incident response.

**Platform requirement** · obligation: **mandatory** · [PDF page 17](pathname:///files/edi-stelsel/2026-11-06/NL-CS-WSCA-conditions-RC1.1_-_for_publ.pdf#page=17)

- **Security principle:** [Cyber Security Monitoring](/edi-stelsel/requirements/nl-cs-wsca-conditions#13)



## 5.4 Operating System / System Services Requirements

[Read section 5.4 in the full text](/edi-stelsel/text/nl-cs-wsca-conditions#s-5-4)

### OS-01 {#os-01}

Only operating system services required for the secure operation, administration and maintenance of the WSCA shall be installed and enabled.

**Platform requirement** · obligation: **mandatory** · [PDF page 18](pathname:///files/edi-stelsel/2026-11-06/NL-CS-WSCA-conditions-RC1.1_-_for_publ.pdf#page=18)

- **Security principle:** [Minimal Configuration](/edi-stelsel/requirements/nl-cs-wsca-conditions#01)



### OS-02 {#os-02}

System services shall execute only authorised binaries and components. Unauthorised modification or replacement of service executables shall be prevented or detected.

**Platform requirement** · obligation: **mandatory** · [PDF page 18](pathname:///files/edi-stelsel/2026-11-06/NL-CS-WSCA-conditions-RC1.1_-_for_publ.pdf#page=18)

- **Security principle:** [Limited Execution](/edi-stelsel/requirements/nl-cs-wsca-conditions#02)



### OS-03 {#os-03}

Each system service required by the WSCA shall operate using the minimum privileges and system resources necessary for its function.

**Platform requirement** · obligation: **mandatory** · [PDF page 18](pathname:///files/edi-stelsel/2026-11-06/NL-CS-WSCA-conditions-RC1.1_-_for_publ.pdf#page=18)

- **Security principle:** [Least Privilege](/edi-stelsel/requirements/nl-cs-wsca-conditions#03)



### OS-04 {#os-04}

System services shall be isolated from the WSCA and from each other to the extent necessary to prevent compromise of one service from directly compromising the WSCA.

**Platform requirement** · obligation: **mandatory** · [PDF page 18](pathname:///files/edi-stelsel/2026-11-06/NL-CS-WSCA-conditions-RC1.1_-_for_publ.pdf#page=18)

- **Security principle:** [Process Isolation](/edi-stelsel/requirements/nl-cs-wsca-conditions#04)



### OS-05 {#os-05}

System services shall operate using the platform's available memory protection mechanisms so that they cannot access or modify WSCA memory without authorisation.

**Platform requirement** · obligation: **mandatory** · [PDF page 18](pathname:///files/edi-stelsel/2026-11-06/NL-CS-WSCA-conditions-RC1.1_-_for_publ.pdf#page=18)

- **Security principle:** [Memory Protection](/edi-stelsel/requirements/nl-cs-wsca-conditions#05)



### OS-06 {#os-06}

Access to system services shall be restricted to authorised users, processes and network endpoints. Unused service interfaces shall be disabled.

**Platform requirement** · obligation: **mandatory** · [PDF page 18](pathname:///files/edi-stelsel/2026-11-06/NL-CS-WSCA-conditions-RC1.1_-_for_publ.pdf#page=18)

- **Security principle:** [Controlled Interfaces](/edi-stelsel/requirements/nl-cs-wsca-conditions#06)



### OS-07 {#os-07}

System service configuration and security policies shall be protected against unauthorised modification.

**Platform requirement** · obligation: **mandatory** · [PDF page 18](pathname:///files/edi-stelsel/2026-11-06/NL-CS-WSCA-conditions-RC1.1_-_for_publ.pdf#page=18)

- **Security principle:** [Platform Integrity](/edi-stelsel/requirements/nl-cs-wsca-conditions#07)



### OS-08 {#os-08}

Network-facing services shall be limited to those required by the WSCA environment. Services that are not required shall be disabled and their associated ports shall not be exposed.

**Platform requirement** · obligation: **mandatory** · [PDF page 18](pathname:///files/edi-stelsel/2026-11-06/NL-CS-WSCA-conditions-RC1.1_-_for_publ.pdf#page=18)

- **Security principle:** [Network Protection](/edi-stelsel/requirements/nl-cs-wsca-conditions#08)



### OS-09 {#os-09}

System services shall not provide unauthorised access to WSCA files, configuration, credentials or other security-relevant data.

**Platform requirement** · obligation: **mandatory** · [PDF page 18](pathname:///files/edi-stelsel/2026-11-06/NL-CS-WSCA-conditions-RC1.1_-_for_publ.pdf#page=18)

- **Security principle:** [WSCA Data Protection](/edi-stelsel/requirements/nl-cs-wsca-conditions#09)



### OS-10 {#os-10}

System services shall be configured to prevent their interfaces or vulnerabilities from being used to obtain privileges that could compromise the WSCA.

**Platform requirement** · obligation: **mandatory** · [PDF page 18](pathname:///files/edi-stelsel/2026-11-06/NL-CS-WSCA-conditions-RC1.1_-_for_publ.pdf#page=18)

- **Security principle:** [Privilege Escalation Protection](/edi-stelsel/requirements/nl-cs-wsca-conditions#10)



### OS-11 {#os-11}

Security-relevant events generated by system services shall be logged where required to detect or investigate activity that could affect WSCA security.

**Platform requirement** · obligation: **mandatory** · [PDF page 18](pathname:///files/edi-stelsel/2026-11-06/NL-CS-WSCA-conditions-RC1.1_-_for_publ.pdf#page=18)

- **Security principle:** [Security-Relevant Logging](/edi-stelsel/requirements/nl-cs-wsca-conditions#11)



### OS-12 {#os-12}

System services and associated components shall be regularly assessed for vulnerabilities and security updates shall be applied where required.

**Platform requirement** · obligation: **mandatory** · [PDF page 18](pathname:///files/edi-stelsel/2026-11-06/NL-CS-WSCA-conditions-RC1.1_-_for_publ.pdf#page=18)

- **Security principle:** [Vulnerability Management](/edi-stelsel/requirements/nl-cs-wsca-conditions#12)



### OS-13 {#os-13}

The operating system shall continuously monitor system services for security-relevant anomalies, including unexpected service behaviour, unauthorised configuration changes, suspicious process activity, and indicators of compromise. Detected events shall be reported to the platform's security monitoring mechanisms for analysis, alerting, and incident response.

**Platform requirement** · obligation: **mandatory** · [PDF page 18](pathname:///files/edi-stelsel/2026-11-06/NL-CS-WSCA-conditions-RC1.1_-_for_publ.pdf#page=18)

- **Security principle:** [Cyber Security Monitoring](/edi-stelsel/requirements/nl-cs-wsca-conditions#13)



## 5.5 Application Space Requirements

[Read section 5.5 in the full text](/edi-stelsel/text/nl-cs-wsca-conditions#s-5-5)

### APP-01 {#app-01}

Only applications and utilities required for the operation, administration and maintenance of the WSCA environment shall be installed.

**Platform requirement** · obligation: **mandatory** · [PDF page 18](pathname:///files/edi-stelsel/2026-11-06/NL-CS-WSCA-conditions-RC1.1_-_for_publ.pdf#page=18)

- **Security principle:** [Minimal Configuration](/edi-stelsel/requirements/nl-cs-wsca-conditions#01)



### APP-02 {#app-02}

Execution of applications, scripts and utilities shall be restricted to authorised software. Application allow-listing or equivalent controls shall be applied where technically feasible.

**Platform requirement** · obligation: **mandatory** · [PDF page 19](pathname:///files/edi-stelsel/2026-11-06/NL-CS-WSCA-conditions-RC1.1_-_for_publ.pdf#page=19)

- **Security principle:** [Limited Execution](/edi-stelsel/requirements/nl-cs-wsca-conditions#02)



### APP-03 {#app-03}

Applications and utilities shall operate with the minimum privileges required for their intended functions.

**Platform requirement** · obligation: **mandatory** · [PDF page 19](pathname:///files/edi-stelsel/2026-11-06/NL-CS-WSCA-conditions-RC1.1_-_for_publ.pdf#page=19)

- **Security principle:** [Least Privilege](/edi-stelsel/requirements/nl-cs-wsca-conditions#03)



### APP-04 {#app-04}

Applications shall be isolated from the WSCA so that compromise of an application does not provide direct access to WSCA processes or resources.

**Platform requirement** · obligation: **mandatory** · [PDF page 19](pathname:///files/edi-stelsel/2026-11-06/NL-CS-WSCA-conditions-RC1.1_-_for_publ.pdf#page=19)

- **Security principle:** [Process Isolation](/edi-stelsel/requirements/nl-cs-wsca-conditions#04)



### APP-05 {#app-05}

Applications shall not be able to read, modify or execute WSCA memory unless explicitly authorised and required for operation.

**Platform requirement** · obligation: **mandatory** · [PDF page 19](pathname:///files/edi-stelsel/2026-11-06/NL-CS-WSCA-conditions-RC1.1_-_for_publ.pdf#page=19)

- **Security principle:** [Memory Protection](/edi-stelsel/requirements/nl-cs-wsca-conditions#05)



### APP-06 {#app-06}

Applications shall have access only to the system interfaces, files, devices and services required for their intended functions.

**Platform requirement** · obligation: **mandatory** · [PDF page 19](pathname:///files/edi-stelsel/2026-11-06/NL-CS-WSCA-conditions-RC1.1_-_for_publ.pdf#page=19)

- **Security principle:** [Controlled Interfaces](/edi-stelsel/requirements/nl-cs-wsca-conditions#06)



### APP-07 {#app-07}

Application binaries and security-relevant configuration shall be protected against unauthorised modification.

**Platform requirement** · obligation: **mandatory** · [PDF page 19](pathname:///files/edi-stelsel/2026-11-06/NL-CS-WSCA-conditions-RC1.1_-_for_publ.pdf#page=19)

- **Security principle:** [Platform Integrity](/edi-stelsel/requirements/nl-cs-wsca-conditions#07)



### APP-08 {#app-08}

Applications shall not establish network connections to untrusted networks unless explicitly required and authorised.

**Platform requirement** · obligation: **mandatory** · [PDF page 19](pathname:///files/edi-stelsel/2026-11-06/NL-CS-WSCA-conditions-RC1.1_-_for_publ.pdf#page=19)

- **Security principle:** [Network Protection](/edi-stelsel/requirements/nl-cs-wsca-conditions#08)



### APP-09 {#app-09}

Applications shall be prevented from accessing WSCA security-relevant data unless explicitly authorised.

**Platform requirement** · obligation: **mandatory** · [PDF page 19](pathname:///files/edi-stelsel/2026-11-06/NL-CS-WSCA-conditions-RC1.1_-_for_publ.pdf#page=19)

- **Security principle:** [WSCA Data Protection](/edi-stelsel/requirements/nl-cs-wsca-conditions#09)



### APP-10 {#app-10}

Applications shall be configured and controlled to prevent exploitation of application vulnerabilities from resulting in unauthorised privilege escalation affecting the WSCA.

**Platform requirement** · obligation: **mandatory** · [PDF page 19](pathname:///files/edi-stelsel/2026-11-06/NL-CS-WSCA-conditions-RC1.1_-_for_publ.pdf#page=19)

- **Security principle:** [Privilege Escalation Protection](/edi-stelsel/requirements/nl-cs-wsca-conditions#10)



### APP-11 {#app-11}

Security-relevant application events that could indicate an attempt to compromise the WSCA environment shall be logged where appropriate.

**Platform requirement** · obligation: **mandatory** · [PDF page 19](pathname:///files/edi-stelsel/2026-11-06/NL-CS-WSCA-conditions-RC1.1_-_for_publ.pdf#page=19)

- **Security principle:** [Security-Relevant Logging](/edi-stelsel/requirements/nl-cs-wsca-conditions#11)



### APP-12 {#app-12}

Applications installed on the platform shall be subject to vulnerability management. Unnecessary or unsupported applications shall be removed.

**Platform requirement** · obligation: **mandatory** · [PDF page 19](pathname:///files/edi-stelsel/2026-11-06/NL-CS-WSCA-conditions-RC1.1_-_for_publ.pdf#page=19)

- **Security principle:** [Vulnerability Management](/edi-stelsel/requirements/nl-cs-wsca-conditions#12)



### APP-13 {#app-13}

Applications in the WSCA environment shall be monitored for security-relevant anomalies, including unauthorised execution, unexpected application behaviour, suspicious process activity, and indicators of compromise. Detected events shall be reported to the platform's security monitoring mechanisms for analysis, alerting, and incident response.

**Platform requirement** · obligation: **mandatory** · [PDF page 19](pathname:///files/edi-stelsel/2026-11-06/NL-CS-WSCA-conditions-RC1.1_-_for_publ.pdf#page=19)

- **Security principle:** [Cyber Security Monitoring](/edi-stelsel/requirements/nl-cs-wsca-conditions#13)



## 5.6 Container / Isolation Layer Requirements

[Read section 5.6 in the full text](/edi-stelsel/text/nl-cs-wsca-conditions#s-5-6)

### CONT-01 {#cont-01}

Container images shall contain only the software, libraries and configuration required for the intended WSCA function.

**Platform requirement** · obligation: **mandatory** · [PDF page 19](pathname:///files/edi-stelsel/2026-11-06/NL-CS-WSCA-conditions-RC1.1_-_for_publ.pdf#page=19)

- **Security principle:** [Minimal Configuration](/edi-stelsel/requirements/nl-cs-wsca-conditions#01)



### CONT-02 {#cont-02}

Only authorised container images and workloads shall be permitted to execute. Container images shall originate from controlled and trusted sources.

**Platform requirement** · obligation: **mandatory** · [PDF page 19](pathname:///files/edi-stelsel/2026-11-06/NL-CS-WSCA-conditions-RC1.1_-_for_publ.pdf#page=19)

- **Security principle:** [Limited Execution](/edi-stelsel/requirements/nl-cs-wsca-conditions#02)



### CONT-03 {#cont-03}

Containers shall execute with the minimum privileges required. Privileged containers shall not be used unless explicitly justified and authorised.

**Platform requirement** · obligation: **mandatory** · [PDF page 19](pathname:///files/edi-stelsel/2026-11-06/NL-CS-WSCA-conditions-RC1.1_-_for_publ.pdf#page=19)

- **Security principle:** [Least Privilege](/edi-stelsel/requirements/nl-cs-wsca-conditions#03)



### CONT-04 {#cont-04}

Containers shall be isolated from the host, other containers and unrelated processes using the platform's available isolation mechanisms.

**Platform requirement** · obligation: **mandatory** · [PDF page 20](pathname:///files/edi-stelsel/2026-11-06/NL-CS-WSCA-conditions-RC1.1_-_for_publ.pdf#page=20)

- **Security principle:** [Process Isolation](/edi-stelsel/requirements/nl-cs-wsca-conditions#04)



### CONT-05 {#cont-05}

Container resource controls shall prevent one container from accessing or exhausting memory resources in a manner that could compromise the WSCA or the underlying platform.

**Platform requirement** · obligation: **mandatory** · [PDF page 20](pathname:///files/edi-stelsel/2026-11-06/NL-CS-WSCA-conditions-RC1.1_-_for_publ.pdf#page=20)

- **Security principle:** [Memory Protection](/edi-stelsel/requirements/nl-cs-wsca-conditions#05)



### CONT-06 {#cont-06}

Container access to host devices, filesystems, kernel interfaces and other host resources shall be explicitly restricted. Unnecessary host mounts and device access shall not be permitted.

**Platform requirement** · obligation: **mandatory** · [PDF page 20](pathname:///files/edi-stelsel/2026-11-06/NL-CS-WSCA-conditions-RC1.1_-_for_publ.pdf#page=20)

- **Security principle:** [Controlled Interfaces](/edi-stelsel/requirements/nl-cs-wsca-conditions#06)



### CONT-07 {#cont-07}

Container images, runtime components and container configuration shall be integrity-protected and changes shall be controlled.

**Platform requirement** · obligation: **mandatory** · [PDF page 20](pathname:///files/edi-stelsel/2026-11-06/NL-CS-WSCA-conditions-RC1.1_-_for_publ.pdf#page=20)

- **Security principle:** [Platform Integrity](/edi-stelsel/requirements/nl-cs-wsca-conditions#07)



### CONT-08 {#cont-08}

Container network connectivity shall be restricted to the connections required for WSCA operation. Unnecessary external network access shall be prevented.

**Platform requirement** · obligation: **mandatory** · [PDF page 20](pathname:///files/edi-stelsel/2026-11-06/NL-CS-WSCA-conditions-RC1.1_-_for_publ.pdf#page=20)

- **Security principle:** [Network Protection](/edi-stelsel/requirements/nl-cs-wsca-conditions#08)



### CONT-09 {#cont-09}

Containers shall not have access to WSCA security-relevant data unless such access is explicitly required for the WSCA function.

**Platform requirement** · obligation: **mandatory** · [PDF page 20](pathname:///files/edi-stelsel/2026-11-06/NL-CS-WSCA-conditions-RC1.1_-_for_publ.pdf#page=20)

- **Security principle:** [WSCA Data Protection](/edi-stelsel/requirements/nl-cs-wsca-conditions#09)



### CONT-10 {#cont-10}

Container configuration and runtime controls shall prevent container processes from escaping their isolation boundary or obtaining unauthorised host privileges.

**Platform requirement** · obligation: **mandatory** · [PDF page 20](pathname:///files/edi-stelsel/2026-11-06/NL-CS-WSCA-conditions-RC1.1_-_for_publ.pdf#page=20)

- **Security principle:** [Privilege Escalation Protection](/edi-stelsel/requirements/nl-cs-wsca-conditions#10)



### CONT-11 {#cont-11}

Container runtime and security events relevant to the protection of the WSCA shall be logged and made available for monitoring where appropriate.

**Platform requirement** · obligation: **mandatory** · [PDF page 20](pathname:///files/edi-stelsel/2026-11-06/NL-CS-WSCA-conditions-RC1.1_-_for_publ.pdf#page=20)

- **Security principle:** [Security-Relevant Logging](/edi-stelsel/requirements/nl-cs-wsca-conditions#11)



### CONT-12 {#cont-12}

Container images, runtimes and supporting components shall be regularly assessed for vulnerabilities. Vulnerable or unsupported images and components shall be updated or removed.

**Platform requirement** · obligation: **mandatory** · [PDF page 20](pathname:///files/edi-stelsel/2026-11-06/NL-CS-WSCA-conditions-RC1.1_-_for_publ.pdf#page=20)

- **Security principle:** [Vulnerability Management](/edi-stelsel/requirements/nl-cs-wsca-conditions#12)



### CONT-13 {#cont-13}

The container runtime and isolation mechanisms shall be monitored for security-relevant anomalies, including unauthorised container creation or modification, attempted isolation-boundary violations, unexpected resource access, and suspicious workload behaviour. Detected events shall be reported to the platform's security monitoring mechanisms for analysis, alerting, and incident response.

**Platform requirement** · obligation: **mandatory** · [PDF page 20](pathname:///files/edi-stelsel/2026-11-06/NL-CS-WSCA-conditions-RC1.1_-_for_publ.pdf#page=20)

- **Security principle:** [Cyber Security Monitoring](/edi-stelsel/requirements/nl-cs-wsca-conditions#13)



## 5.7 WSCA Execution Environment Requirements

[Read section 5.7 in the full text](/edi-stelsel/text/nl-cs-wsca-conditions#s-5-7)

### WSCA-01 {#wsca-01}

The WSCA execution environment shall contain only the runtime components, libraries, configuration and supporting functionality required by the WSCA.

**Platform requirement** · obligation: **mandatory** · [PDF page 20](pathname:///files/edi-stelsel/2026-11-06/NL-CS-WSCA-conditions-RC1.1_-_for_publ.pdf#page=20)

- **Security principle:** [Minimal Configuration](/edi-stelsel/requirements/nl-cs-wsca-conditions#01)



### WSCA-04 {#wsca-04}

The WSCA shall be isolated from unrelated applications, services and processes such that compromise of another component does not provide direct access to the WSCA.

**Platform requirement** · obligation: **mandatory** · [PDF page 21](pathname:///files/edi-stelsel/2026-11-06/NL-CS-WSCA-conditions-RC1.1_-_for_publ.pdf#page=21)

- **Security principle:** [Process Isolation](/edi-stelsel/requirements/nl-cs-wsca-conditions#04)



### WSCA-05 {#wsca-05}

The WSCA execution environment shall enforce memory protection mechanisms preventing unauthorised access to WSCA memory and security-relevant runtime data.

**Platform requirement** · obligation: **mandatory** · [PDF page 21](pathname:///files/edi-stelsel/2026-11-06/NL-CS-WSCA-conditions-RC1.1_-_for_publ.pdf#page=21)

- **Security principle:** [Memory Protection](/edi-stelsel/requirements/nl-cs-wsca-conditions#05)



### WSCA-06 {#wsca-06}

The WSCA shall have access only to the platform interfaces, devices, files and services required for its specified operation.

**Platform requirement** · obligation: **mandatory** · [PDF page 21](pathname:///files/edi-stelsel/2026-11-06/NL-CS-WSCA-conditions-RC1.1_-_for_publ.pdf#page=21)

- **Security principle:** [Controlled Interfaces](/edi-stelsel/requirements/nl-cs-wsca-conditions#06)



### WSCA-07 {#wsca-07}

WSCA binaries, libraries and security-relevant configuration shall be protected against unauthorised modification.

**Platform requirement** · obligation: **mandatory** · [PDF page 21](pathname:///files/edi-stelsel/2026-11-06/NL-CS-WSCA-conditions-RC1.1_-_for_publ.pdf#page=21)

- **Security principle:** [Platform Integrity](/edi-stelsel/requirements/nl-cs-wsca-conditions#07)



### WSCA-08 {#wsca-08}

Network communication from the WSCA shall be restricted to explicitly authorised endpoints and protocols required for its operation.

**Platform requirement** · obligation: **mandatory** · [PDF page 21](pathname:///files/edi-stelsel/2026-11-06/NL-CS-WSCA-conditions-RC1.1_-_for_publ.pdf#page=21)

- **Security principle:** [Network Protection](/edi-stelsel/requirements/nl-cs-wsca-conditions#08)



### WSCA-09 {#wsca-09}

Security-relevant WSCA data shall be protected against unauthorised disclosure, modification and deletion by the underlying platform and other processes.

**Platform requirement** · obligation: **mandatory** · [PDF page 21](pathname:///files/edi-stelsel/2026-11-06/NL-CS-WSCA-conditions-RC1.1_-_for_publ.pdf#page=21)

- **Security principle:** [WSCA Data Protection](/edi-stelsel/requirements/nl-cs-wsca-conditions#09)



### WSCA-10 {#wsca-10}

The execution environment shall prevent the WSCA or its supporting components from obtaining privileges beyond those required for their specified functions.

**Platform requirement** · obligation: **mandatory** · [PDF page 21](pathname:///files/edi-stelsel/2026-11-06/NL-CS-WSCA-conditions-RC1.1_-_for_publ.pdf#page=21)

- **Security principle:** [Privilege Escalation Protection](/edi-stelsel/requirements/nl-cs-wsca-conditions#10)



### WSCA-11 {#wsca-11}

Security-relevant events affecting the WSCA execution environment shall be logged where necessary to support detection and investigation of security events.

**Platform requirement** · obligation: **mandatory** · [PDF page 21](pathname:///files/edi-stelsel/2026-11-06/NL-CS-WSCA-conditions-RC1.1_-_for_publ.pdf#page=21)

- **Security principle:** [Security-Relevant Logging](/edi-stelsel/requirements/nl-cs-wsca-conditions#11)



### WSCA-12 {#wsca-12}

All runtime components, libraries and supporting software on which the WSCA depends shall be subject to vulnerability management and security-update processes.

**Platform requirement** · obligation: **mandatory** · [PDF page 21](pathname:///files/edi-stelsel/2026-11-06/NL-CS-WSCA-conditions-RC1.1_-_for_publ.pdf#page=21)

- **Security principle:** [Vulnerability Management](/edi-stelsel/requirements/nl-cs-wsca-conditions#12)



### WSCA-13 {#wsca-13}

The WSCA execution environment shall be continuously monitored for security-relevant anomalies, including unauthorised changes to runtime components or configuration, unexpected WSCA behaviour, suspicious resource access, and indicators of compromise. Detected events shall be reported to the platform's security monitoring mechanisms for analysis, alerting, and incident response.

**Platform requirement** · obligation: **mandatory** · [PDF page 21](pathname:///files/edi-stelsel/2026-11-06/NL-CS-WSCA-conditions-RC1.1_-_for_publ.pdf#page=21)

- **Security principle:** [Cyber Security Monitoring](/edi-stelsel/requirements/nl-cs-wsca-conditions#13)



### WSCA-02 {#wsca-02}

Only authorised WSCA binaries, libraries and supporting components shall be permitted to execute within the WSCA execution environment.

**Platform requirement** · obligation: **mandatory** · [PDF page 20](pathname:///files/edi-stelsel/2026-11-06/NL-CS-WSCA-conditions-RC1.1_-_for_publ.pdf#page=20)

- **Security principle:** [Limited Execution](/edi-stelsel/requirements/nl-cs-wsca-conditions#02)



### WSCA-03 {#wsca-03}

The WSCA shall execute with the minimum operating system and platform privileges required to perform its specified security functions.

**Platform requirement** · obligation: **mandatory** · [PDF page 20](pathname:///files/edi-stelsel/2026-11-06/NL-CS-WSCA-conditions-RC1.1_-_for_publ.pdf#page=20)

- **Security principle:** [Least Privilege](/edi-stelsel/requirements/nl-cs-wsca-conditions#03)
